name: miniprojectty
description: This repository contains the campus placement management system built by four teams working together through a shared contract and API model.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix team-a && npm install --prefix team-b && npm install --prefix team-c && npm install --prefix team-d
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix team-a && npm run build --prefix team-b && npm run build --prefix team-c && npm run build --prefix team-d
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:a" "npm run dev:b" "npm run dev:c" "npm run dev:d"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:a && npm run test:b && npm run test:c && npm run test:d && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:playwright && npm run test:kpi
